$comment: IBKR connection policy. Default is IB Gateway Desktop / TWS TCP socket (paper 4002 / 7497). Client Portal Web API (HTTPS :5000) is opt-in only via mode=web_api. Reviewed config — not a UI knob. Do not lower RiskEngine/OMS gates to compensate for broker transport.
_marketDataRejectionComment: 2026-09-20 remediation for the Sept 18 rejection-triggered subscription desync (docs/audits): a reqMktData rejected with 354/10089 previously left the symbol permanently marked locally as already-subscribed, so it was never retried without an explicit external trigger. These keys govern the bounded per-symbol retry/backoff that replaces that silent-forever behavior. Deliberately a slower, coarser schedule than networkReconnectBackoffMs (transport reconnect) - an entitlement rejection is a different, slower-changing condition than a dropped socket.
_lifecycleHardeningComment: 2026-09-21 Phase 2 (post-adversarial-audit): marketDataConfirmationTimeoutMs above no longer causes a rejection - silence alone (no tick, no error, no IBKR acknowledgement callback) is real evidence of nothing, not evidence of failure, and is never allowed to trigger RETRY_WAIT. It now only flags an honest NO_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT diagnostic. marketDataUnconfirmedReprobeMs governs the much slower, bounded self-healing reissue for a symbol that stays unacknowledged (distinct from - and far less aggressive than - the explicit-rejection retry schedule above, since an unconfirmed request is weaker evidence of a real problem than an explicit 354/10089). The entitlement* keys govern the account-wide circuit breaker: only a genuine cluster of independent canary (protected-symbol) entitlement errors suppresses ordinary per-symbol retries, never a single symbol's own error.
